ShortDescription.Value: Make milestone progression slower and more population-driven.

Publish.LongDescription:
Progression Controls reshapes milestone XP without replacing the game's milestones, rewards, development points, loan limits, or unlocks.
## Features
- Award XP when the city reaches a new all-time population record. - Scale future vanilla XP from 0% to 100%. - Accumulate fractional population XP without losing progress to rounding. - Apply every change prospectively without recalculating existing XP. - Disable the mod to restore full vanilla XP and make it dormant.
## Presets
- **Population Balanced:** population XP plus 50% vanilla XP. - **Population Heavy:** population XP plus 25% vanilla XP. - **Population Only:** population XP with vanilla XP suppressed.
Show Advanced exposes linked XP-per-resident and projected Megalopolis-target inputs, the vanilla XP multiplier, and population update responsiveness.
## Save safety
Progression Controls adds no required components to city saves. Earned XP and milestones remain normal game state, and cities continue loading after the mod is disabled or removed.
## Compatibility
Unlimited Money is supported. Unlock All bypasses milestone progression, so XP changes have no meaningful visible effect. Other mods that intercept XP or replace milestone behavior are unsupported.
Publish.ChangeLog:
Initial private package:
- Population Balanced, Population Heavy, Population Only, and Custom rules. - Population XP at new all-time population records. - Vanilla XP scaling from 0% to 100%. - Save-safe external checkpoints and dormant disable behavior.
